# Stacked ARC panel overlay

Use for 12×6 inputs that encode four aligned 3×6 panels stacked vertically, where the output is a 3×6 cellwise merge.

## Rule learned from demonstrations

For each output coordinate `(r, c)`, inspect the four input cells at `(r,c)`, `(r+3,c)`, `(r+6,c)`, and `(r+9,c)`. Return the highest-priority nonzero color:

3. Submit exactly three output rows of six values.
4. Verify all 18 positions against the four source cells before submitting.
